summary: v2v extend app integration, blocked on the 1.4 release

Re-scoped on two counts. (1) The blocker was stale: the card said BLOCKED until 1.4 ships (MPI-450), and MPI-450 closed done/complete at 2026-08-10T19:46:56Z. Maturity stays blocked, the reason changed. (2) The card was written as a MODEL op - extend in commandRegistry.js plus supportedOps/workflows in models.js - but per project_ltx_workflows_land_as_flows it is a FLOW: a FlowDef in flowsRegistry.js via /mpi-add-flow, no ModelDef, no supportedOps, no dependencies.js entry, running on the already-wired LTX 2.3 checkpoint. Work item 1 SURVIVES the reframe unchanged - the injector is the same for Flows, so restoring Input_Width/Input_Height as MpiInt is still required or the resolution picker is silently dead.
